rows.title: The hedged lane
rows.body: Hedges line the road, with gaps at the garden gates. You look through as you pass.
rows.placement: Two straight rows of cut hedges, one per 7 m cell, with aligned gate gaps every 6 cells. Blocked slots stay empty. One encounter anchor holds two ordinary slimes where safe ground permits.

rows.title: Gone to seed
rows.body: Saplings crowd the verge beneath tall pines. You push past branches reaching into the street.
rows.flash: The green is taking it back.
rows.placement: One attempt every 12 m; a sapling-to-mature tree progression, at most 42 trees per line piece.

rows.title: Orchard Lane
rows.body: Apples hang from the old orchard trees.
rows.placement: One attempt every 12 m, both verges; at most 80 trees per line piece, alternating half fruit trees (rare Worldpeach among apples) and half mature deciduous maples.

rows.title: Pilgrim's Way
rows.body: Smooth, rounded stones lie beside the road. Each lights beneath your feet. Keep them all glowing together.
rows.placement: One compact set of 3–6 rounded waystones per street per tile; step on all before their light fades.

rows.title: Lantern Row
rows.body: Lamp posts line the road, close enough to light the whole street. You walk between the rows of lamps.
rows.placement: Lamps at 4.166666666666667 m target spacing (4× the usual path density); no extra verge props.

rows.title: Burned Row
rows.body: Hot embers glow between the road stones, burning like lava underfoot. Tar fills the gutters, and iron stakes jut from the verge.
rows.placement: Glowing ember paving damages the player like lava. One attempt every 8 m; at most 100 tar/stakes per line piece. Placed torches punctuate the verges; red lamps have 66.66666666666667 m target spacing. One fire-slime guard site per stretch, seated back from the kerb.

rows.title: The barricade
rows.body: Rough barricades cross the road and reach into the verges. Iron spikes stand between the wooden barriers.
rows.placement: Perpendicular lines of stakes and barricades cross the road every 50 m and extend up to 4 cells beyond either edge, stopping at obstacles; a target of 80 pieces per line piece, finishing the last cross-road line. A Trap Kit removes each piece. One encounter anchor and its goblin guard site per street per tile.

rows.title: Toadstool Lane
rows.body: Red toadstools crowd the verge, and the air smells of damp earth. You step around their spotted caps.
rows.placement: One attempt every 6 m; at most 100 mushrooms per line piece. Mushrooms only, in three-on/one-gap groups with varying verge setbacks.

rows.title: The promenade
rows.body: The path runs along the water. You listen to it lapping against the shore as you walk.
rows.selection: Off-road walking path beside qualifying shore water.
rows.rewards: 2× first-restoration metre credit; one T5 one-time vista chest per eligible stretch of at least 120 m. Daily path-lamp credit is unchanged.
rows.placement: Geography selects the scenic row; real scenic stretch dressing seats vista chests off the path. No additional themed verge plants.

rows.title: A greenway
rows.body: Branches hang low over the path. You duck beneath them as leaves brush your hood.
rows.selection: Off-road walking path with a greenway name or route.
rows.rewards: 1.75× first-restoration metre credit; one T5 one-time vista chest per eligible stretch of at least 120 m. Daily path-lamp credit is unchanged.
rows.placement: Geography selects the scenic row; real scenic stretch dressing seats vista chests off the path. Grass along both verges every 10 m where ground permits.

rows.title: The park path
rows.body: Weeds crowd the old park path, and dry leaves cover its edges. You follow it through the overgrowth.
rows.selection: Off-road walking path inside a named or sufficiently large park.
rows.rewards: 1.75× first-restoration metre credit; one T5 one-time vista chest per eligible stretch of at least 120 m. Daily path-lamp credit is unchanged.
rows.placement: Geography selects the scenic row; real scenic stretch dressing seats vista chests off the path. No additional themed verge plants.

rows.title: Golden Road
rows.body: A gilded shrine stands beside the road. Touch it each day, and green coins spill along both sides of the road.
rows.placement: A golden idol holds eligible coin seats along both verges, sampled every 3.5 m. Visiting it starts the daily coin spree; coins are not permanent street dressing. Road, lamp and occupied cells stay clear.

rows.title: Snare Lane
rows.body: A chest sits beside the lane, surrounded by iron traps. Open jaws stretch across the road and both verges.
rows.placement: One T3 cave-loot chest at the street midpoint, surrounded by up to 24 traps on eligible verge ground. At least 8 traps must fit.

rows.title: Thorny Way
rows.body: Tangled brambles crowd both sides of the road. You follow the narrow opening between their thorns.
rows.placement: Irregular bramble clusters at 60% density cross the road and reach up to 4 cells beyond either edge, stopping at the first obstruction. Selected streets enclose a moss cairn in brambles when the whole ring fits. Brambles burn and cost 1 energy per second while crossed.

rows.title: Goblin Gang Street
rows.body: Goblin grunts gather in little gangs beside stacks of barrels along the street.
rows.placement: 6 candidate gangs beside barrel stacks, with up to 5 barrels per cluster where eligible verge cells remain.

rows.title: Golden Path
rows.body: A gilded shrine stands beside the path. Touch it each day, and green coins appear in a line down the path.
rows.placement: An activation shrine at each safe end shares one daily activation. Coins appear directly on the path centerline, so either direction works without backtracking or a second payout.

rows.title: Slime Trail
rows.body: Wet slime gleams across the path. A colony of slimes has claimed this trail.
rows.placement: Glossy slime paving. One seeded species per section, chosen from green, purple, fire or splitting slimes. Two guards at each eligible post every 70 m; short sections use a midpoint post. No daily reset.

rows.title: Spider Path
rows.body: Lasting webs lie scattered across the path. Spiders lurk nearby; touching silk briefly pins you in place.
rows.placement: Permanent seeded webs on 35% of eligible cell-spaced samples, with scattered lateral offsets. Webs cause six seconds of paralysis on entry; flying actors are immune. One two-spider garrison per section, where safe ground permits.

rows.title: Poison Path
rows.body: Poison geysers erupt beside the path. A shrine offers a daily boon along the way.
rows.placement: Seeded poison geysers alongside the path, where hazard placement is safe. A matching daily shrine stands on each eligible section.

rows.title: Fire Path
rows.body: Fire geysers erupt beside the path. A shrine offers a daily boon along the way.
rows.placement: Seeded fire geysers alongside the path, where hazard placement is safe. A matching daily shrine stands on each eligible section.

rows.title: Paralysis Path
rows.body: Paralysis geysers erupt beside the path. A shrine offers a daily boon along the way.
rows.placement: Seeded paralysis geysers alongside the path, where hazard placement is safe. A matching daily shrine stands on each eligible section.

rows.title: Confusion Path
rows.body: Confusion geysers erupt beside the path. A shrine offers a daily boon along the way.
rows.placement: Seeded confusion geysers alongside the path, where hazard placement is safe. A matching daily shrine stands on each eligible section.

rows.title: Berry Lane
rows.body: Bushes crowd both verges: berries, poison berries and thorns, and once in a long while a golden one. Something small may be hiding behind them.

rows.title: Berry Trail
rows.body: Bushes crowd the trail: berries, poison berries and thorns, and once in a long while a golden one. Something small may be hiding behind them.

rows.title: Pottery Road
rows.body: Clay pots stand along both sides of the road. Most are empty, but a coin rolls out of the odd one you smash.
rows.placement: Clay pots along both verges, one sample a cell with 35% left empty, each a cell back from the kerb on the reward gate. No guards.

rows.title: Trade Row
rows.body: Barrels of goods line both sides of the road, and goblin grunts pick through them in twos.
rows.placement: Wooden barrels along both verges, one sample a cell with 30% left empty, a cell back from the kerb on the reward gate; a two-grunt post every 25 m, 67% of them held, seated behind the barrels.

rows.title: Rocky Road / Path
rows.body: Loose stones and low rocks line this simple route.

rows.title: Grassy Lane
rows.body: Soft grass, herbs and small bushes line the lane.

rows.title: Old Growth Path
rows.body: Mature trees shade a path edged with shrubs and mushrooms.

rows.title: Haunted Forest Path
rows.body: Dark trees crowd the way. Old headstones stand among the mushrooms.

rows.title: Way of Variety
rows.body: Common finds crowd both sides: herbs, berries, mushrooms, rocks, trees and pots.

baseline.title: Old Trade Road
baseline.body: Deep wheel ruts run past the remains of broken wagons. You follow the old trade road.
